title: Paired ESP and noncovalent-interaction analysis of E/Z-H2bte
difficulty_reasons: The molecular pair and observables are fixed, but the agent must independently select a defensible computational protocol and validate surface and interaction analyses.

paper.title: Synthesis and structural characterization of the Z-isomer of 1,2-bis(tetrazol-5-yl)ethylene (H2bte) via photoinduced isomerization

data.description: Self-contained XYZ starting geometries and manifest for neutral singlet E- and Z-H2bte.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-isomer calculations, ESP extrema, NCI/LOL-p observations, comparison, limitations, and conclusion.
